scripts.title: i made a script that is detected by robloxs anticheat LOL
scripts.script:
local function foo()
    print("bar")
end
local info = debug.getinfo(foo)
local func_str_cluttered = tostring(info.func)
local func_str = string.gsub(func_str_cluttered, "function: ", "")
print(func_str)
local get_func_addr = loadstring("return " .. func_str)
local func_addr = get_func_addr()
local info_fromaddr = debug.getinfo(func_addr)
scripts.features: quite funny, i did not know a script could be detected
